label: Diagram 12.1
caption: Diagram 12.1 Limitations on spacing and size of plastic rooflights that have a class D-s3, d2 or TP(b) lower surface
description: The drawing is a plan view. Two rectangles, each outlined by a double line, are placed one above the other; both are labelled 'Rooflight*' with 'max. area 5m²' below the label. A green double-headed arrow points between them, carrying the text '3m minimum between any two rooflights in any direction'. The top left corner reads 'See paras 12.5 and 12.6'. To the right, a line states '* Or group of rooflights amounting to no more than 5m²'. Beneath it, under 'NOTES:', three numbered items read: 1. 'There are restrictions on the use of plastic rooflights in the guidance to requirement B2 in Section 4.' 2. 'Surrounding roof covering to be a material of class A2-s3, d3 or better for at least 3m distance.' 3. 'Where Diagram 5.2a or 5.2b applies, rooflights should be at least 1500mm from the compartment wall.' A green banner along the bottom gives the title 'Diagram 12.1 Limitations on spacing and size of plastic rooflights that have a class D-s3, d2 or TP(b) lower surface'.
